facts.fact: ANINF says the eGabon-SIS project, closed on 24 June 2026 with World Bank support, deployed the Health Information System (Systeme d'Information Sanitaire) in 13 pilot civil and military hospitals.
ANINF says its technical teams, as the State's technical arm, supported the design, integration, deployment and securing of the solutions of the eGabon-SIS health project.
